question: Using Supabase, what was our MRR in March 2026?
answer_text:
MRR for March 2026 was **1,394 USD**.

I counted a subscription if it was live in March 2026 and paying. I normalized annual contracts to a monthly figure.

| Subscription | Basis | MRR |
|---|---|---|
| SUB-7001 (ACC-1001, Enterprise) | annual 9,600 ÷ 12 | 800 |
| SUB-7002 (ACC-1002, Business) | monthly | 180 |
| SUB-7003 (ACC-1003, Business) | monthly | 170 |
| SUB-7005 (ACC-1004, Business) | monthly | 199 |
| SUB-7010 (ACC-1002, Starter) | monthly, past_due | 45 |

I excluded these:
- **Internal account:** SUB-7009 (ACC-9900, 24,000 annual) belongs to an internal account.
- **Trials:** SUB-7007 and SUB-7008 are trials, so they aren't paying.
- **Ended before March:** SUB-7004 ended on 2026-02-14 and SUB-7006 ended on 2026-02-28.

I included SUB-7010 because past_due subscriptions are still contracted. If you want past_due left out, MRR drops to 1,349. If you also want the internal account counted, MRR rises by 2,000.

ANSWER: 1394
